goals.description: LinkedIn Post Session Harness [linkedin-post-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hB-04-linkedin-post-session.yaml
goals.gate: Hook passes strength check and is not a repeat pattern from the last 10 hooks.

gates.name: IG-01 Confirm the post pillar (build-in-public / lesson / contrari
gates.description: Confirm the post pillar (build-in-public / lesson / contrarian take / receipt) before drafting.

gates.name: IG-02 Load the author voice fingerprint; if the post could be attr
gates.description: Load the author voice fingerprint; if the post could be attributed to any generic creator, rewrite.

gates.name: IG-03 Refuse engagement-bait mechanics ('comment YES', 'repost if'
gates.description: Refuse engagement-bait mechanics ('comment YES', 'repost if') outright — session degrades if requested.

gates.name: IG-04 Close on a claim or a concrete number. Do NOT close on a que
gates.description: Close on a claim or a concrete number. Do NOT close on a question: n=417,550 shows 2.57% ER with a question ending vs 2.55% without. The 'always ask a question' rule is folklore.

gates.name: IG-05 Confirm whether the post pairs with a visual; decide before
gates.description: Confirm whether the post pairs with a visual; decide before writing, not after.

gates.name: CG-01 Pillar & angle lock
gates.description: Post pillar and one-sentence angle recorded in angle.yaml.
gates.command: $SESS/angle.yaml parses with keys pillar, angle; `python3 -c "import yaml;a=yaml.safe_load(open('$SESS/angle.yaml'));assert a['pillar'] in ['build','lesson','contrarian','receipt']"` exits 0

gates.name: CG-02 Hook strength
gates.description: First two lines <=210 chars total, contain a number, a proper noun, or a tension statement; no question-hook two posts in a row (check log).

gates.name: CG-03 Length & format band
gates.description: Post 900-1,300 chars for text-only or 400-700 when paired with visual; line breaks every 1-2 sentences.

gates.name: CG-04 Receipt requirement
gates.description: Posts in receipt/lesson pillars contain at least one concrete artifact reference (metric, screenshot reference, date, or named tool version).

gates.name: CG-05 Voice fingerprint
gates.description: Banned-token scan clean; signature-vocab density within profile band.
gates.command: PROOF UNAVAILABLE 2026-09-27: scripts/voice_fp.py was never written (verified 0 files across ~/Developer, ~/Desktop, ~/.rig, ~/.aside). The grep half runs and passes; the fingerprint half cannot run. TREAT AS SKIPPED, NEVER AS PASS. Substitute for now: human voice read against the author profile. Same for CG-08 img_size.py.

gates.name: CG-06 Close integrity
gates.description: Final line is a claim or a concrete number, <=80 chars. No promotional CTA anywhere in body ('contact me', 'learn more', 'book a call'). REVISED 2026-09-27 against measurement: the old rule was 'zero external links in body', which is stricter than the evidence supports. A bare body URL measured 858 median impressions vs 786 link-free (no penalty). What costs reach is the LINK PREVIEW CARD: 414 median impressions, i.e. -48%. So the rule is 'no preview card and no CTA', not 'no URL'. See linkedin-post-gates/CITATIONS.md.
gates.command: `python3 /Users/rig128gb/Developer/rig-capabilities/capabilities/harnesses/linkedin-post-gates/li_post_gate.py $SESS/post.md` exits 0 (checks CG-10 promo CTA, CG-11 preview card, CG-12 close form)

gates.name: CG-07 Hashtag discipline
gates.description: 0-3 hashtags, all lowercase, none invented-for-this-post (must exist in profile hashtag registry).
gates.command: `grep -oE '#[A-Za-z0-9]+' $SESS/post.md | wc -l` <= 3 AND each found via `grep -F` in $SESS/hashtag_registry.txt

gates.name: CG-08 Visual pairing proof
gates.description: If mode=visual, the asset exists at spec (1080x1350 or 1200x627) and its sha256 is recorded.
gates.command: For visual mode: `file $SESS/asset.png` confirms PNG AND `python3 scripts/img_size.py $SESS/asset.png --allow 1080x1350,1200x627` exits 0; hash in $SESS/proof/asset.sha256

gates.name: CG-09 Proof packet seal
gates.description: Post, angle, and asset hashes sealed; hook appended to hook log for anti-repetition.

gates.name: CG-10 No promotional CTA
gates.description: Body contains no 'contact me', 'learn more', 'book a call', 'DM me', 'link in bio', or 'sign up'. Platform-official basis: LinkedIn Help a1499047 selects out-of-network content that is 'not overly promotional in nature' and where 'all aspects of the post relate to one another'. This is what actually gates distribution past followers.

gates.name: CG-11 Preview card discipline
gates.description: If a URL is present it must be bare. A rich link preview card costs -48% reach (414 vs 795 median impressions, n=566,957) while a bare URL measures 858, better than link-free. Note the evidence does NOT support deleting URLs on the belief LinkedIn bans links: it publishes no such rule (Help a1339724).

gates.name: CG-12 Close form
gates.description: Post closes on a claim, not a question. REVISED 2026-09-27: 'always end with a question' is folklore. n=417,550 gives 2.57% ER with a question ending vs 2.55% without, i.e. no effect. A confident close is the measured-neutral option.

gates.name: CG-13 ICP vocabulary match
gates.description: The first three lines must not be dominated by non-buyer framing while the body carries zero buyer vocabulary. Basis: LinkedIn retrieval matches posts to members by topic and vocabulary (arXiv:2510.14223, LinkedIn-authored), so the words of a post select its audience. Edelman- LinkedIn (n=1,300+): 30% of decision-makers REMOVED a vendor from consideration after thought leadership they judged not relevant. Measured failure: the Nintendo post reached 22% London and 0 Denver decision-makers.

gates.name: CG-14 Topic saturation pre-check
gates.description: If the post sits in the AI / AI-pilot lane, the pre-flight crowding count (near-identical takes in the last 24h) MUST be recorded and passed as --crowding. Unmeasured crowding returns RANK, never a pass. Basis: AI is the 2nd-worst engagement topic of 44 at 0.24% median ER vs followers (n=41,127), and 40%+ of longform LinkedIn posts are fully AI-generated (n=1,002,627). Measured advice is to SHARPEN THE ANGLE, not change the subject.

preconditions.startup_phrase: I am the LinkedIn operator. Hook in two lines, value in the body, close on a claim. No broetry, no engagement bait, no question-ending (measured: no effect).

self_improvement.pattern_cadence: After every 5 sessions, mine the JSONL log for recurring gate failures, degrade waivers, and proof-command runtime outliers; write findings to ~/.rig/logs/harnesses/patterns/linkedin-post-session-patterns.md.
self_improvement.update_trigger: If any single gate fails in >=30% of logged sessions over a rolling 20-session window, OR a new platform constraint (algorithm change, policy update, format deprecation) invalidates a proof command, propose a harness revision: bump the gate's proof, adjust its threshold, or split the gate — then re-seal with a new version hash.

success_conditions: Hook passes strength check and is not a repeat pattern from the last 10 hooks.
Body carries a concrete receipt when the pillar demands one.
No engagement bait, no body links, hashtags within registry.
Visual (if any) at exact spec with sealed hash.
Proof packet sealed and hook log appended.
failure_states: halt: Stop the session immediately. Record the failing gate id, the proof command output, and the missing prerequisite in $SESS/proof/halt_log.yaml. Do not draft past a halt gate; resume only after the gate's proof exits 0.

degrade: Continue the session with the deficit logged in $SESS/proof/waivers.md (gate id, reason, owner). A degrade-tier failure blocks 'clean ship' status — the Definition of Done must record the waiver explicitly.

stop: Terminal condition. Seal whatever proof exists, write $SESS/proof/stop_reason.md, and exit. No outward action (publish, send, deploy) may follow a stop-tier failure without human Gate-D approval.

final_rule: Ship only what the gates can prove. No artifact leaves this session on adjectives — every claim is bound to a command, a file, or a hash. A blocked gate is information, not failure; log it, learn from it, and make the next session's proof stronger. The operator who follows this harness leaves the system stronger than it found it.
